The Union recognizes the need for improved methods and output in the interest of the employees and the business, and agrees to cooperate with the Employer in the installation of such methods, in suggesting improved methods, and in the education of its members in the necessity for such changes and improvements.

extraction_text: In the event that the Employer contemplates the introduction of major technological changes affecting bargaining unit work, advance notice of such change will be given to the Union. If requested to do so, the Employer will meet with the Union to discuss the implementation of such changes before putting such changes into effect.

extraction_text: In any discussions that are forthcoming as a result of technological change, both parties are agreed that they will make every effort to arrive at mutually agreeable decisions with regard to those full-time members of the bargaining unit (on the payroll as of the March 5, 2001) who may become displaced as a direct result of the technological change.
